# telnyx_10dlc_enum (Data Source)

The accepted values of one 10DLC enumeration, such as use cases, verticals or entity types, for building brand and campaign configurations. The values are in `values` as JSON, because their shape depends on the enumeration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) The endpoint.

### Read-Only

- `values` (String) The response, as JSON: a map whose keys the API does not fix. A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
